senses.gloss: m. (partial reduplic. of ספק) [satiating nourishment,] bran mixed with flour, coarse meal (cmp. קִיבָר).
units: <cite ref="Gittin 56b:7">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>מיא דס׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>דסִיפְקָא</he>, Rashi <he>דסִיפּוּקָא</he>) coarse flour-water.
<cite ref="Pesachim 42a">Pes. 42ᵃ</cite> bot. (a gloss to <he>פת קיבר</he>, missing in ed.) <he>ריפתא ס׳</he> Ar. (Ms. M. <he>ר׳ דסיפיקא</he>; Ms. O. <he>פת ספסוקא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
